If sentiment is positive (≥0.67) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is negative (≤0.33) in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to compensate for bearish bias.  
If sentiment is neutral (0.33–0.67) and price is trending upward, apply a 0.5–1.0% downward correction in late horizon (16–30 days) to prevent overshoot.  
When sentiment swings from positive to negative within 5 days, apply a 2.0–3.0% downward correction across all horizons to reflect sentiment reversal.  
If sentiment is consistently positive over 10+ days, reduce forecast slope by 0.1–0.3% per day for late horizon to avoid inflationary drift.  
If sentiment is consistently negative over 10+ days, increase forecast slope by 0.1–0.3% per day for early horizon to counteract deflationary pressure.
